READING COMPREHENSION (2.4 POINTS)

12 Câu hỏi

I. Choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for the following context (0.2 point)

II. Read the passage and circle the correct answer A, B, C or D (1.0 point)

People around the world celebrate the New Year in different ways. In New York, thousands of people gather at Times Square to (27) _______ the New Year. They enjoy the cheering and (28) _______ until midnight. In Viet Nam, Tet is a very special time. Vietnamese people usually throw some old things (29) _______ and clean their houses before Tet. On New Year's Eve, many families cook banh chung on an open (30) _______. They believe that buying salt on the first days of the year will bring happiness. Children also dress beautifully and get lucky money in red envelopes. Everyone behaves well to avoid (31) _______ luck for the whole year.

III. Read the passage and do the tasks below (1.2 points)

Dear Diary,

Today is New Year's Eve, and my family is preparing many interesting things to welcome the New Year. Right now, my parents are cleaning the living room, and my sister is dressing beautifully. This afternoon, we threw some old things away to make our house tidy. My grandfather says we should buy salt for happiness at the beginning of the year. We shouldn't break things or fight during this special time because it may bring bad luck. My brother and I will watch the beautiful fireworks at midnight. I am also writing a quick email to my penfriend in London to tell him about our customs. I hope the New Year will bring good luck, health, and happiness to everyone.

Task 1: Decide whether the statements are True (T) or False (F)
Task 2: Answer the questions in brief
D

MINI REVIEW - TỔNG HỢP KIẾN THỨC BÀI HỌC

Từ vựng quan trọng:

  • • welcome (v): đón chào
  • • salt (n): muối ăn (mang lại may mắn)
  • • lucky money (n): tiền lì xì
  • • open fire (n): bếp lửa ngoài trời

Cấu trúc & Điểm ngữ pháp cần nhớ:

  • • Should / Shouldn't + V-bare: Nên / Không nên làm gì (khuyên bảo).
  • • Too (cũng vậy - câu khẳng định) vs Either (cũng không - câu phủ định).
  • • Avoid + V-ing: Tránh làm điều gì.
